Hi all — looping in a short, pragmatic position from Finance/Commercial (cc Grace & Laura). We want to enable pilots with minimal negotiation friction while protecting our unit economics. Proposed final language for the appendix: 

1) Band A ("Exploratory") — $7,500/mo: non-refundable credit; for operational risk mitigation we can offer an SLA credit: if we experience an availability incident attributable to Redwood exceeding 8 hours in aggregate in a 60-day window, Acme will receive a one-time service credit equal to 50% of that month's commit (credited to future invoices). This is limited to a single incident per pilot.

2) Band B ("Standard Pilot") — $20,000/mo: unused monthly commit may be converted, at Acme's election, to a one-time professional services credit (up to 100% of the unused portion) valid for Redwood professional services (integration, prompt engineering, redaction) within 90 days. Alternatively, Acme can elect a 30-day roll-forward of unused commit.

3) Band C ("Pilot Plus") — $40,000/mo: 16% discount; we allow a 60-day roll-forward or a 50% refund of unused commit as a one-time credit toward future usage if usage remains below 70% of commit for the pilot duration. Rebate triggers and exceptions documented in appendix.

Operational notes: we will include standard monitoring/tracing obligations and an incident playbook to qualify for SLA credits. DocuSign-ready appendix and compact ratecard attached. If Acme signs the appendix, CS will schedule onboarding and a 2-week ramp plan.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Head of Commercial Finance, Redwood Inference
